scope: Detailed Chromium MemoryInfra, unambiguously associated through begin/end UserTiming spans. Renderer and other process providers remain separate. Per-category frontier selects topmost provided paths to avoid nested double counting; categories must not be added to OS footprint or treated as universal tab/GPU totals. Root effective_size, size and allocated_objects_size are preserved. Missing provider values are not evidence of zero native use. B/T/F snapshots force GC and load profiler metadata: these are diagnostic allocations, not natural-GC footprint benchmarks.
